/* selectAuthGrp - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT AUTHRT_ID, AUTHRT_NM, INST_TYPE_SE_CD, INST_NO, (SELECT D.INST_NM FROM SAA000 D /* 통합기관 */ WHERE D.INST_NO = C.INST_NO) AS INST_NM, ENFSN_ROLE_SE_CD, DEL_YN, RM_CN, SRTNG_SQNCE, MDFCN_YN FROM SAB400 C /* 권한 */ /* WHERE DEL_YN IS NULL OR DEL_YN != 'Y' */ WHERE 1=1
AND C.AUTHRT_NM LIKE '%'||#{AUTHRT_NM}||'%'
ORDER BY SRTNG_SQNCE, AUTHRT_ID

/* selectMaxAuthrtId - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT SAB400_SQ01.NEXTVAL AS MAX_AUTHRT_ID FROM DUAL
